discovery_notes.navigation: Login -> ERPNext Home -> Global Search by exact DocType name -> DocType List -> New <DocType> (or validated New) -> blank document -> read all fields -> back to Module
discovery_notes.doctype_validation: DocType is accepted from a clean /app/<doctype> list route and the opened list page is UI-validated; no metadata API dependency.
discovery_notes.record_rule: Existing business documents are not opened for discovery; only the blank New Document form is inspected.
discovery_notes.system_ui_rule: Notification, Bell, Search, Filter, Settings, Workspace and other system UI are ignored and never treated as DocTypes.
discovery_notes.field_rule: Visible form fields are read for fieldname, label, fieldtype, required state, placeholder/options and available actions.
discovery_notes.tab_section_rule: Every visible form tab is opened and read one-by-one; fields are stored with tab context, and sections are collected from each tab.
discovery_notes.blank_form_rule: The agent reads the blank New Document without filling or saving business data.
discovery_notes.ai_knowledge_rule: The JSON is an observation record for future AI retrieval/planning, not a test execution result.
